'''CSX''' was a domestic [[Wikipedia:Stock market index|stock index]] that operated around the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] at one point noted that CSX was trending downward relative to the [[Top Million]] index.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>
